Rich Geldreich's rg_etc1, from devkitPro tex3ds v2.3.0 (37220c696e873812df41af62d1db0b20c66661fe). The zlib license is in rg_etc1.h. Only the host asset baker links this library.

The radix sorter reads the exact key length via memcpy for unaligned 16-bit keys.

The base-color refinement clamps signed values after a signed conversion.
